d: In this episode of Guest in the Newsroom, Vedanta Group's chairman, billionaire businessman Anil Agarwal, is the guest. He spoke openly about the allegations against Vedanta. Anil Agarwal shared his journey of leaving home at the age of 19 in 1973 and moving to Mumbai, starting from scratch to become a billionaire. He also discussed Harshad Mehta, PM Modi, and Rahul Gandhi. Anil Agarwal revealed whether it's necessary to give political donations to do business in this country. He also addressed the debate about working 70 and 90 hours a week.
